title: Officials asked whether he had a mental connection to the triangle

tellings.quote: when I came forward, they were very interested if I had a connection to the triangle.

plain: When Dylan Borland, a man who says a top government official told him aliens run everything, came forward with his story, officials are said to have been "very interested" in whether he had a mental connection to "the triangle," the triangle-shaped craft at the centre of his account. Borland tells this himself. It suggests the officials thought a witness might be linked to such a craft by the mind and not only by sight.
